findings.title: Candidate revocation names rollback that the closed rollback machine forbids from being created
findings.requirement: A live exposed improvement must revoke authority and enter exactly one real rollback saga; every coordinate delta needs one named synchronized owner.
evidence: IC32 changes candidate SHADOW_PASSED->REVOKED and says ‘start rollback if live’, but its canonical projection is only REDUCE-V1 and it names no rollback_state edge or saga creation.
§15.3.1 says rollback entry is owned exactly once only by IR19, IR22, exposed IW/IWD/IP/IPD rows, and IH01-W/P/D/O; IC32 is absent.
§15 says ‘no delta is inferred’, so IC32 cannot legally infer IDLE->REQUESTED.
findings.impact: Revocation can occur while rollout exposure is live, yet the manifest either leaves exposure without the required rollback or requires an unlisted transition that the compiler must reject. This is an unsafe and undefined normative path.
findings.required_correction: Partition IC32 by exposure/live-rollout state. Add exact synchronized rollout/effect/rollback coordinates, IDLE->REQUESTED, single-saga creation, canonical projection, and later cleanup owner for exposed cases; add a protected no-exposure failure/cleanup path where rollback is not required. Include the new rows in the exhaustive rollback-entry owner set and witnesses.

findings.title: Canary abort settlement has reachable exposure and E34 branches with no satisfiable IR13A/IR13B exit
findings.requirement: PLAN §8.4 requires every safety abort to prove either verified real rollback after exposure or protected no exposure, then use one later cleanup owner.
evidence: IH01-C can move an exposed CANARY_RUNNING generation to CANARY_PAUSED without creating rollback. IR07, IR09/IR11, and IR10 can then reach CANARY_ABORTING/CANARY_ABORTED, but none is in §15.3.1’s complete rollback-entry owner set.

IR13A requires a bound rollback already verified/rolled-back. IR13B instead requires NoExposureReceipt and ‘complete effect-set absence’. Thus an exposed abort produced by these rows cannot satisfy either branch.

IR43 maps widening E34 to CANARY_ABORTING after E34 has made the Effect FAILED_FINAL. Its no-application fact does not satisfy IR13B’s literal complete-effect-set-absence guard because the terminal Effect record exists, while IR13A is inapplicable because exposure is absent.
§15.8 says E34 uses IR43 and separately says exactly one of IR13A/IR13B settles the abort, but supplies no witness or row that bridges either mismatch.
findings.impact: A safety stop, control failure after pause, child failure/cancellation, or widening E34 can strand the parent nonterminal after effects are stopped/settled. Exposed branches also lack the required verified rollback before cleanup.
findings.required_correction: Create exact mutually exclusive exposed/no-exposure abort-entry rows for every reachable IR07/IR09/IR10/IR11 path. Exposed rows must atomically create the one rollback saga; no-exposure rows must carry a protected classifier. Make IR43’s terminal no-application Effect compatible with the no-exposure settlement guard (for example, require settled non-applied effects rather than effect-set absence), and add exact witnesses through IR13C/IX03.
